statusLabel: PBS access being extended (was due to end 1 Nov 2026)
expectedReturn: access change, not a manufacturing shortage
mechanism: PBS funding/access change, per TGA/PBS and AstraZeneca notices
note: Zoladex 3.6 mg was due to leave the PBS on 1 November 2026. AstraZeneca has since told the TGA it will keep supplying it and extend PBS access, and it is not on the PBS deletions list for 1 November 2026; ask the pharmacist for the current position. This site will check this again after 1 November 2026. Triptorelin 3.75 mg (Diphereline) has had no PBS restriction since 1 October 2026, but its listing is not for use in gender dysphoria in minors.

The TGA expects shortages of Provera 10 mg (new embossing) from 7 December 2026 and Ralovera 5 mg and 10 mg from late November and December 2026; other strengths and brands remain available. No record for Depo-Provera. Depo-Ralovera injection is no longer registered in Australia (ARTG 44464 cancelled from 19 June 2026); Depo-Provera is the injection available.
